selected_script.angle: Clanging closet clutter and falling broom hazards solved instantly
selected_script.hook: A heavy mop leans against a wall, slips, and crashes loudly onto a laundry room floor, spilling a bucket.

script_record.0-3s: A wooden broom leans against a laundry wall, slips, and crashes onto the floor next to a tipped-over dustpan.
script_record.3-6s: A hand presses a mop handle into a white Command Broom Gripper with grey rubber inner jaws mounted on a clean white wall. The jaws snap tightly around the handle.
script_record.6-10s: A close-up shot shows the broom handle floating securely off the laundry floor, held firmly in the white mount.
script_record.10-14s: A panning shot of a kitchen pantry wall shows two white Command Broom Grippers holding a broom and a mop neatly.
script_record.14-18s: A hand easily pulls a broom handle out of the gripper, showing the clean wall surface.
script_record.18-20s: Text overlay: Clean up your closet clutter today.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create the first 10-second segment of a vertical TikTok-style ad. 0-3s: Pain conflict. A realistic handheld phone-shot video of a wooden broom leaning against a laundry room wall, slipping, and crashing onto the tile floor. 3-6s: Product solution. A hand presses a mop handle into a white molded plastic Command Broom Gripper with grey rubber inner gripping jaws mounted on a clean wall. The jaws snap tightly around the handle. 6-10s: Fast-cut Scene 1. Close-up of the broom handle held firmly off the floor with no wobble. Product appearance must match the white plastic body and grey rubber inner jaws of the reference image. No CTA in this segment. 9:16 aspect ratio, realistic handheld movement, natural lighting.

Create the continuation 10-second segment of a vertical TikTok-style ad. 0-4s: Fast-cut Scene 2. A close-up panning shot of a kitchen pantry wall showing two white Command Broom Grippers aligned side-by-side holding a broom and a mop neatly. 4-8s: Fast-cut Scene 3. A hand easily pulls a broom handle straight out of the gripper. 8-10s: Light CTA text overlay reads: 'Clean up your closet clutter today.' Use the reference image to maintain exact product details: white plastic mount and grey rubber inner jaws. Maintain continuity with the first segment. 9:16 aspect ratio, realistic handheld movement, natural lighting.
